Dick Piotrowski never gave up chasing Pat over the last mile and Roger Donnison in taking third place again produced a steady and consistent performance.

Roger Donnison who is now becoming one of our regular team members was on the first of the short stages and ran most of the way with Geoff Biscoe (Mitcham) who left him on the run in and forced us back to 6th.

Next came Roger Donnison and although achieving third best time of the day had to be content with remaining in third place. He caught and passed Tipton but in turn was displaced by Hammond of Coventry who put up the fastest time on this stage.
The news of Bill's departure had hardly percolated through the Club before we received the equally disappointing news that Roger Donnison will have moved to Exeter before the end of the year.
Competition for team selection can lead only to success in the major races. Roger Donnison is to be congratulated on his best cross country run to date in Belgrave colours.

Roger Donnison (27th) and Lionel Mann (31st) ran well and will be a tower of strength to our teams this year. We also finished a 'B' team which finished well down but it was pleasing to see Bryan Buxton in operation again.

A few weeks ago we had visions of a strong enough team to win this race but with the departure of Roger Donnison for a job in Exeter, the sickness over Christmas and the New Year of Kelly Diprose and the injury of Bob Smith we were deprived of three potential scorers.
